title: When the Detention Sings
author: Sebastian Dravenmoor
blurb: Lena Thornbury, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
